newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine expects Yeltsin to visit in June.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine expects Yeltsin to visit in June.

text.p: Russia's prime minister is to visit Ukraine on May 28 to pave the way for President Boris Yeltsin to visit Kiev in June to sign a broad political agreement, a presidential spokesman said on Thursday.
"The document has no name yet but it will be an all-embracing political agreement," the spokesman for President Leonid Kuchma said.
Russian President Boris Yeltsin has cancelled six trips to Kiev to sign a Friendship Treaty with Ukraine's president since Ukraine broke free of Moscow's rule in 1991.
The spokesman said the Russian president's arrival would depend on the results of Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin's visit on May 28 and 29 but added: "Yeltsin has promised to come in early June".

Relations between the two biggest former Soviet republics have been strained by disagreements over the division of the former Soviet Black Sea Fleet based on Ukraine's Crimea peninsula, mainly inhabited by ethnic Russians.
Another official at Kuchma's office said the date of Chernomyrdin's visit had been agreed when he spoke to Kuchma by telephone on Wednesday.
